findings.description: The Lambda function's environment variables embed a plaintext AWS access key ID and secret access key. These values are stored in Terraform source/state and are readable by anyone with GetFunctionConfiguration permission, so the credentials must be treated as compromised; secrets should come from Secrets Manager or SSM Parameter Store at runtime.

The function runs on nodejs12.x, an end-of-life runtime that no longer receives security patches, so any known vulnerability in the runtime or its bundled dependencies remains exploitable in production.
